approved_decision.rule: Recognize PARAZAM- as a governed analytical stem for the PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI family and recognize final O/I as a closed contrast within this pair only. The analysis is NONPRODUCTIVE_CLOSED_PAIR and does not establish a general HNK final-vowel morphology.
approved_decision.rationale: PARAZAMO and PARAZAMI share all segments except final O/I and remain in the same study/learning semantic family, making them the strongest current minimal-pair evidence for a family-specific final-vowel contrast. A single pair remains insufficient for language-wide O/I rules.

governance_decisions.decision: Do not create PARAZAM as a standalone lexical entry under B8.
Do not define final O as a general noun/domain marker under B8.
Do not define final I as a general verb/action marker under B8; B9 owns that broader question.
Do not license new PARAZAM+Vowel forms or any productive derivation from this pair.
B8 changes no lexical authority, semantics, grammar, curriculum slots or L03 state; PARAZAMO remains FROZEN and PARAZAMI remains WATCH unless separately governed.
